raw_document.title: ThetaBio and GlobalPharma Enter Global License Agreement for THB-501 — Up to $1.2 Billion Deal
raw_document.raw_text:
ThetaBio Inc. (NASDAQ: THBI) and GlobalPharma Group today announced a global license and co-development agreement for THB-501 (thetavexumab), ThetaBio's investigational anti-IL-33 monoclonal antibody for asthma and atopic dermatitis.

Under the terms of the agreement:
- GlobalPharma will pay ThetaBio a $150 million upfront payment
- ThetaBio is eligible to receive up to $1.05 billion in development, regulatory, and commercial milestones
- Total potential deal value: up to $1.2 billion
- GlobalPharma will assume responsibility for all Phase 3 development and commercialization outside the United States
- ThetaBio retains US commercialization rights
- ThetaBio is eligible for tiered royalties on net sales of 8-15% in ex-US markets

THB-501 is currently in Phase 2 development (NCT04789012) for moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. The ongoing trial has enrolled 340 patients.

'This agreement provides significant non-dilutive capital that will fund our US clinical development and commercial build-out,' said CEO Patricia Yang. 'GlobalPharma's global infrastructure will accelerate our ability to bring THB-501 to patients worldwide.'

The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions and is expected to close in Q2 2024.
